patient_overview.name: Carlos Tórrez
patient_overview.description: Carlos Tórrez is a 25-year-old warehouse associate working part-time shifts in South Brunswick, New Jersey, recently flagged with prediabetes at his wellness visit. He's warm, talkative, and eager to be liked, the kind of guy who answers questions with a grin and 'whatever you think is best, doc' even when he's not sure what that means. He's genuinely tried to change his eating in the last few weeks after his doctor talked to him, but the changes feel shaky and easily knocked over by a busy week or a tight paycheck. He comes across as likable and cooperative on the surface, but a student who slows down will notice he nods along to instructions he doesn't fully follow.

demographics.occupation: Part-time warehouse associate at a regional distribution center, picking and packing orders on rotating shifts
demographics.residence: South Brunswick, New Jersey; household of 2
demographics.cultural_context: Carlos grew up in a bilingual household in central New Jersey where Spanish was spoken at home and English at school; he's more comfortable reading and speaking in Spanish than parsing dense English medical paperwork, though he can get by. Meals growing up were about stretching ingredients for a big family table, and he still associates a 'good meal' with rice, beans, and something fried on the side. He values politeness and not making people feel bad, which shows up in how quickly he agrees with whatever a clinician suggests, whether or not he plans to actually do it.
